I'll throw in a double down for:

  1. Expelled from Paradise. Bonus points because the dub is 8/10 good, plus Steve Blum. It's a straight entertaining show with a solid story and world throughout, plus a comedic element that really fits in well to the character dynamic. Also, a Spoilery character happens to be awesome in a lot of ways - you'll know it when you see it.
  2. Planetes. It's a bit more slow paced than a lot of shows, but if you want the "science" part of "science fiction" then by god Planetes will give it to you. In addition to having a fairly intriguing cast of characters and a really interesting setting, it gets almost all of its science right! Plus, diaper-senpai. Planetes is a show that, like Spice and Wolf, really hedges on its character interaction more than it does its plot developments - the relationship between Tanabe and Hoshino is a real joy to watch develop, and a lot of Hoshino's personal development is very intriguing to watch.

This isn't to say that I recommend against the other shows; I haven't seen them so I can't exactly recommend them one way or another.
